mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_plan_assignments WHERE user_id = #{userId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_plan_assignments (user_id, plan_key, entitlement_version, status, period_start, period_end) SELECT #{userId}, pe.plan_key, pe.version, 'ACTIVE', #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd} FROM plan_entitlements pe WHERE pe.plan_key = 'NORMAL' AND pe.version = 1
